*It's been several days since summer break started.*
*But there's no rest for the Library Club. We've still got a mountain of requests to handle.*
*That's all thanks to an unusual event held in Shiomi Academy - the Summer Festival.*
*All of the students suddenly have way more time on their hands when summer break commences.*
*Many of them go back to their families, go on trips, or busy themselves with part-time work, but these distractions don't last for the entire summer break.*
*Most of the students of Shiomi Academy stay in or around the area.*
*In others words, when summer break comes around, there are always tens of thousands of students hanging around the town.*
*The first club to capitalize on the overflowing numbers of bored students was supposedly the Exploration Club.*
*They held a treasure hunt during this period. It was a huge success despite minimal advertising.*
*The other clubs noticed the opportunity and started to hold events and projects of their own.*
*Soon enough, there was an event held on every day of the summer break.*
*That was how the Summer Festival was born.*
*There's now a Summer Festival Study Group which aggregates information on all events and publishes an event calendar on their website.*
*The most common topic of conversation for students in this period (excepting people like my reading addiction-addled self) is the Summer Festival by far.*
*Though right now, my job is to mediate between clubs.*
Kakei: All right, then...
*What should I do for breakfast?*
*If I recall correctly, there should be some milk that's dangerously close to expiring in the fridge.*
*I believe there's also a meal's worth of cereal left at the bottom of the box.*
